verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs describe AI-driven insights from your trace data inside the product. It trains signals from plain-English failure descriptions and backfills history, clusters similar findings so patterns surface on their own, judges alert incidents as real or benign, and pinpoints what shifted when agent behavior drifts. For suggestions, it proposes reusable fixes (skills, subagents, nudges) that are shadow-tested and promoted, plus a plain-language memory of learned failure patterns and fixes. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and only marketing-level detail on how suggestions are generated and shown to users in the dashboard.
